messages:
Elena (People Ops): Quick People Ops update — please read when you have 2–3 minutes. Effective May 1 were making three changes: 1) PTO accrual adjustment for new hires (details below), 2) parental leave extended to 16 weeks fully paid, and 3) a streamlined travel exception process for low-cost conferences. Also: all staff please complete the Code of Conduct refresher by May 15. Full policy doc: https://redwood-internal.company/policies/people-updates (link internal). React with :white_check_mark: when youve read.

Raj (Eng): Thanks! Quick q — what's the new PTO accrual for hires in yr1?

Elena (People Ops): Good q. New hires now accrue PTO at 1.5 days/month for the first 12 months (previously 1.25). After 12 months standard accrual applies. Rollover cap unchanged at 15 days. 

Ava (Product): Does the parental leave change apply to folks who are currently on leave? Or only new leaves starting May 1?

Elena (People Ops): Applies to any leave starting on or after May 1. If youre currently on leave and want to transition to the new policy, ping me and we'll handle case-by-case.

Tom (Finance): Travel exception — is the "under $3k" limit total per person or per trip? Also who signs off?

Elena (People Ops): Under $3k per trip, per person. Approval flow: manager + finance fast-track. For eligible trips we have a short form that skips Exec review. Use the new fast-track form at: https://redwood-internal.company/forms/travel-fasttrack

Nora (Recruiting): Any changes to recruiter travel budgets for on-campus events? Those are usually <$1k but frequent.

Elena (People Ops): No change to hiring/travel budgets — those remain under recruiting ops. Fast-track form still applies if individual trip <$3k, but recurring or programmatic spend should go through your manager + recruiting finance for a bulk approval.

Raj (Eng): thx. Also, rollover cap stays 15? Confirming.

Elena (People Ops): Confirmed — rollover cap remains 15 days. We considered increasing it but kept it to encourage regular time off.

Ava (Product): How do we confirm we completed the Code of Conduct refresh? Is there a quiz?

policy-bot: ACTION REQUIRED: Code of Conduct refresher assigned to all staff. Complete by May 15. Link: https://redwood-internal.company/learning/coc-refresh. Completion will be recorded automatically.

Elena (People Ops): When you finish the refresher the policy-bot will mark you as complete. If you have issues accessing the training, DM me or open a ticket in #help. We plan a short all-hands Q&A on May 6 at 10am PT for any questions.

Tom (Finance): For reimbursements on fast-track trips, keep receipts and use the usual expense flow. If "auto-approved" by fast-track, still submit within 30 days.

Raj (Eng): :white_check_mark:

Ava (Product): :thumbsup:

Nora (Recruiting): Quick FYI for hiring managers — parental leave policy update is in the offer templates. Recruiting will push new templates by EOD.

Elena (People Ops): Thanks team. FAQ highlights (short):
- Effective date: May 1
- Parental leave: 16 weeks paid, applies to births/adoptions and starts on leave start date
- PTO accrual (yr1): 1.5 days/month; rollover cap 15 days
- Travel fast-track: < $3k per person per trip, manager + finance approval via fast-track form
- Code of Conduct refresher: complete by May 15 (policy-bot will track)

If you need an exception to any of the above (e.g., multi-week travel, large conference spend), please use the Exception Request form and CC your manager. Link: https://redwood-internal.company/forms/exception-request

If you want a one-pager summary for your team, reply with "one-pager" and Ill drop it here.

Raj (Eng): one-pager

Elena (People Ops): Dropping a quick one-pager now — short version pinned in #people-ops and attached to the policy doc. Thanks everyone!
